title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 4.2 Graph Linear Equations in Two Variables: Recognize the relationship between the solutions of an equation and its graph
summary: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 4.2 Graph Linear Equations in Two Variables: Recognize the relationship between the solutions of an equation and its graph
body: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, section "4.2 Graph Linear Equations in Two Variables", prints these objectives: "Recognize the relationship between the solutions of an equation and its graph" "Graph a linear equation by plotting points" "Graph vertical and horizontal lines". The section text says: "In the previous section, we found several solutions to the equation 3 x + 2 y = 6 . They are listed in Table 4.10 . So, the ordered pairs ( 0 , 3 ) , ( 2 , 0 ) , and ( 1 , 3 2 ) are some solutions to the equation 3 x + 2 y = 6 . We can plot these solutions in the rectangular coordinate system as shown in Figure 4.5 ." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
